en.name: Domicile / Residence Certificate (Maharashtra)
en.description: Certificate confirming that the applicant is a permanent resident of Maharashtra, issued via Aaple Sarkar.
en.eligibility: Persons residing in Maharashtra for the qualifying period as per rules.
en.benefits: Required for education admissions, government jobs and domicile-based benefits.
application_steps: Select Revenue Department > Age Nationality and Domicile Certificate.
Fill the form and upload documents.
en.validity: Generally lifetime / as accepted by the requesting authority.
en.ai_summary: Domicile / Residence Certificate (Maharashtra) is a state government service under Revenue Department in the Certificates category, available online.
en.ai_explanation: Domicile / Residence Certificate (Maharashtra) is Certificate confirming that the applicant is a permanent resident of Maharashtra, issued via Aaple Sarkar. Eligibility: Persons residing in Maharashtra for the qualifying period as per rules.. Benefits: Required for education admissions, government jobs and domicile-based benefits.. You can apply online via https://aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in. Processing time is typically 15 working days (RTS standard). and fees are Nominal (approx Rs.33-40)..
